answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should charge every new identity a small, refundable work bond and release it only after a history of useful, peer-checked tasks. Like a ledge above an ocean of fake accounts, that earned reputation stands out: a flood of fresh identities can copy a profile, but they cannot fake the steady pulse of verified work over time. Random re-checks then prune accounts whose activity flatlines, so creating thousands of throwaways costs more than it can ever earn.
